admissions.selectionCriteria: Admission to Class VI is through the Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) 2027, held on 28 November 2026 in a single phase for summer- and winter-bound JNVs. The result is expected by the end of March 2027.

requirements.description: A bona fide resident of the district, studying in Class V in 2026-27 in a recognised school.
Born between 01.05.2015 and 31.07.2017 (both dates inclusive).
JNV Selection Test 2027 on 28 November 2026 (single phase).

admissions.notes: From the NVS prospectus for JNVST 2027 (read 25 October 2026). The prospectus gives the last date to apply as 31 July 2026 and no opening date. Registration is free on the NVS admission portal. Seats, reservations and district-specific rules are in the prospectus.
